requirement: recently-intercepted rows already covered by a list are collapsed, and a row the operator adds to a list disappears from the list immediately

assertions.folder_in: the state route annotates each recent row with whitelist / blacklist / null
assertions.collapse: the panel shows covered rows behind "已在名单中 N 条 · 展开/收起" and they carry no add buttons
assertions.disappear: adding a folder from a recent row prunes that row and every row inside the folder server-side
